achievements.name: Just Getting Started
achievements.description: Get to sector 5.

achievements.name: Federation Base in Range
achievements.description: Get to sector 8.

achievements.name: Federation Victory (Easy)
achievements.description: Beat the boss on Easy.

achievements.name: Federation Victory (Normal)
achievements.description: Beat the boss on Normal.

achievements.name: Your Own Fleet
achievements.description: Unlock the Type A layout for every playable ship.

achievements.name: Rule Ten: Greed is Eternal
achievements.description: Collect 10,000 scrap across all games.

achievements.name: Warlord
achievements.description: Defeat 1000 ships across all playthroughs.

achievements.name: I don't need no stinkin' upgrades!
achievements.description: Get to sector 5 with no system/reactor upgrades.

achievements.name: Coming in for my Pacifism run!
achievements.description: Get to sector 5 without firing a shot, using an offensive drone, or teleporting.

achievements.name: On a Wing and a Prayer
achievements.description: Get to sector 5 without repairing at a store.

achievements.name: Ballistophobia
achievements.description: Get to sector 8 without using missiles/bombs.

achievements.name: Technophobia
achievements.description: Get to sector 8 without using drones.

achievements.name: Living off the Land
achievements.description: Get to sector 8 without buying at a store (Repairs are ok).

achievements.name: No Redshirts Here
achievements.description: Get to sector 8 without losing a crewmember.

achievements.name: Some people just like to watch ships burn
achievements.description: Have every square of an enemy ship on fire simultaneously.

achievements.name: Astronomically Low Odds
achievements.description: Fail to evade 5 shots in a row with a fully powered and upgraded engine.

achievements.name: They never saw it coming
achievements.description: Use the Weapon Pre-Igniter augmentation to destroy an enemy ship in one volley before the enemy can get a single shot off.

achievements.name: BOARDING OBJECTIVE SUCCESSFUL
achievements.description: Have a single boarding drone kill 4 crewmembers on one ship.

achievements.name: Trustworthy Auto-Pilot
achievements.description: Defeat an enemy ship with all of your crew aboard it.

achievements.name: Slice and Dice
achievements.description: Hit every room of a ship with at least one beam in under 5 seconds.

achievements.name: Victory through Asphyxiation
achievements.description: Empty the oxygen (Net level less than 5 percent) of a non-automated, hostile enemy ship.

achievements.name: The United Federation
achievements.description: Have six unique aliens on the Kestrel Cruiser simultaneously.

achievements.name: Full Arsenal
achievements.description: Have 11 systems installed on the Kestrel Cruiser at one time.

achievements.name: Tough Little Ship
achievements.description: As the Kestrel Cruiser, repair back to full health when it only has 1 HP remaining.

achievements.name: Shields Holding
achievements.description: Destroy a ship before it gets through the Zoltan Shield.

achievements.name: Givin' her all she's got, Captain!
achievements.description: With the Zoltan Cruiser, have 29 power in systems at the same time.

achievements.name: Manpower
achievements.description: Get to sector 5 without upgrading your reactor in the Zoltan Cruiser.

achievements.name: Bird of Prey
achievements.description: Destroy a ship at full health during a single cloak in the Stealth Cruiser.

achievements.name: Phase Shift
achievements.description: With the Stealth Cruiser, avoid 9 points of damage during a single cloak.

achievements.name: Tactical Approach
achievements.description: With the Stealth Cruiser, get to sector 8 without jumping to a beacon with an environmental danger.

achievements.name: Robotic Warfare
achievements.description: With the Engi Cruiser, have 3 drones functioning at the same time.

achievements.name: I hardly lifted a finger
achievements.description: With the Engi Cruiser, destroy an enemy ship using only drones (no weapons).

achievements.name: The guns... They've stopped
achievements.description: Have 4 enemy systems or subsystems ioned at the same time while using the Engi Cruiser.

achievements.name: Is it warm in here?
achievements.description: Have your crew kill a burning enemy on their ship while using the Rock Cruiser.

achievements.name: Defense Drones Don't Do D'anything!
achievements.description: While using the Rock Cruiser, destroy an enemy ship which has a defense drone deployed using only missiles.

achievements.name: Ancestry
achievements.description: Find the secret sector with the Rock Cruiser.

achievements.name: Take no prisoners!
achievements.description: Kill the crew of 20 ships by sector 6 in the Mantis Cruiser.

achievements.name: Avast, ye scurvy dogs!
achievements.description: Kill 5 enemy crew in a fight without taking hull damage or losing a crewmember while using the Mantis Cruiser.

achievements.name: Battle Royale
achievements.description: While using the Mantis Cruiser, kill the last enemy with your last crewmember on their ship.

achievements.name: We're in Position!
achievements.description: While using the Slug Cruiser, have vision of every room of the enemy ship without functioning sensors.

achievements.name: Home Sweet Home
achievements.description: Jump to 30 nebula locations before sector 8.

achievements.name: Disintegration Ray
achievements.description: While using the Slug Cruiser, kill 3 enemy crewmembers with one shot from the Anti-Bio Beam.

achievements.name: Master of Patience
achievements.description: Use only the Artillery Beam to destroy an enemy ship while taking no hull damage.

achievements.name: Diplomatic Immunity
achievements.description: While using the Federation Cruiser, use your crew in 4 special blue event choices by sector 5.

achievements.name: Artillery Mastery
achievements.description: Get to sector 5 in the Federation Cruiser without upgrading your Weapons system.

achievements.name: Sweet Revenge
achievements.description: Destroy an enemy ship with a shard from the Crystal Vengeance augment while using the Crystal Cruiser.

achievements.name: No Escape
achievements.description: While using the Crystal Cruiser, trap 4 enemy crew inside a single room using Crystal Lockdown or the Lockdown Bomb.

achievements.name: Clash of the Titans
achievements.description: Destroy 10 Rock ships using the Crystal Cruiser.

achievements.name: Advanced Mastery
achievements.description: Have Hacking, Mind Control and the Battery active at once.

achievements.name: Scrap Hoarder
achievements.description: Have at least 600 scrap in your ship storage.

achievements.name: Loss of Cabin Pressure
achievements.description: Get to sector 8 without your ship's net oxygen levels exceeding 20 percent (starts after the first jump).
